sentences.text: GS Industry Service Oy is a company registered on 2026-01-10 under the industry code 33150, repair and maintenance of civilian ships and boats.
First sales are recorded on 2026-01-10, a start-up notification and a board change on 2026-01-15, a further board change on 2026-03-23 and a first hire on 2026-08-27.
No grant, EU project, public contract or funding record is on file.
For the fund this is a watchlist case: the registered industry is on the thesis list, but no public record yet shows technology or growth.
